scope: Compact export of recorded measurements; detailed arrays removed, not a new experiment.

protocol.policy: Reuse identical fitted candidates and fixed 20000 benign calibration rows per network. Choose model-stage and calibration target on selection windows only. Then freeze before held-out development scoring. No protected suffix read.
protocol.rationale: The selection-window FPR slightly exceeds the deployment cap for otherwise high-recall pooled candidates. A pre-held-out safety-margin control tests feasibility without relaxing the evaluation cap. Ranking metrics will be reported separately so threshold changes cannot be claimed as improved discrimination.
